title: Hydrogen Mass Repartitioning

sections.heading: Learning Outcomes
sections.text:
Understand the reasoning behind repartitioning the mass of a molecule to make hydrogen heavier
Be able to use parmed to do hydrogen mass repartitioning on an existing topology file (parm7)

sections.heading: Process
sections.text:
parmed diala.parm7
ParmEd: a Parameter file Editor
Loaded Amber topology file parm7
Reading input from STDIN...
>
hmassrepartition
Repartitioning hydrogen masses to 3.024 daltons. Not changing water hydrogen masses.
>
outparm diala_hmass.parm7
Outputting Amber topology file diala_hmass.parm7
> quit
Done!
"How's that for maxed out?"
